## Database Schema

```sql
CREATE TABLE public.quick_notes (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    title text NOT NULL,
    description text,
    content text,
    status text CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'active', 'completed')),
    user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id),
    tags text[],
    is_pinned boolean,
    created_at timestamptz,
    updated_at timestamptz
);
```

### RLS Policies:
- Users can read their own notes
- Users can insert their own notes
- Users can update their own notes
- Users can delete their own notes

### Functions:
- `get_user_notes_count()` - Returns count of user's notes
- `get_user_notes_by_status(status)` - Filters notes by status

## API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/quick-notes` | GET | List all user's notes (with status filter) |
| `/api/quick-notes` | POST | Create new note |
| `/api/quick-notes/[id]` | GET | Get single note by ID |
| `/api/quick-notes/[id]` | PATCH | Update note |
| `/api/quick-notes/[id]` | DELETE | Delete note |

### Example Usage:

**Create Note:**
```typescript
const response = await fetch('/api/quick-notes', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    title: 'My Note',
    description: 'Test note',
    content: 'This is a test',
    status: 'pending'
  })
});
```

**List Notes:**
```typescript
const response = await fetch('/api/quick-notes?status=pending');
const { data } = await response.json();
```

**Update Note:**
```typescript
const response = await fetch(`/api/quick-notes/${id}`, {
  method: 'PATCH',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'completed' })
});
```

**Delete Note:**
```typescript
const response = await fetch(`/api/quick-notes/${id}`, {
  method: 'DELETE'
});
```

## Security

### Authentication:
All API routes require authentication via Supabase Auth.

### Authorization:
- RLS policies ensure users only see their own notes
- All operations filtered by `user_id`
- No cross-user data access possible

## Usage

### Access the Feature:
Navigate to: `http://localhost:3000/quick-notes`

### Create Your First Note:
1. Fill in the title (required)
2. Add description and content (optional)
3. Select status
4. Click "Create Note"

### Manage Notes:
- Click "Edit" to modify inline
- Click "Complete" to mark as done
- Click "Delete" to remove
- Use filter dropdown to view by status

## Rollback

To remove this feature:

```sql
-- Run the rollback SQL from the migration file
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS set_quick_notes_updated_at ON public.quick_notes;
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.handle_quick_notes_updated_at();
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.get_user_notes_by_status(text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.get_user_notes_count();
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.quick_notes CASCADE;
```

Or revert the commit:
